title: Launch Monitor Ball Speed Baseline Drift Alert
dataSources: Golf rounds (`golf:round`), Garmin golf telemetry (`garmin:golf`), UDisc rounds (`udisc:round`), launch-monitor shots (`launchmonitor:shot`), handicap-index updates (`handicap:index`).
app: Arccos and Garmin S62 round telemetry, UDisc round exports, launch-monitor CSVs, and handicap-index updates streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted imports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=launchmonitor:shot
| timechart span=1d avg(ball_speed_mph) as metric
| eventstats avg(metric) as base, stdev(metric) as sd
| eval delta=round(metric-base,2), drift=if(abs(delta)>2*sd,1,0)
| where drift=1
description: Flags days where launch monitor ball speed moved far away from your recent baseline instead of staying within normal variation.
value: Large baseline drift is a quick way to surface bad days, breakout days, or sensor issues without waiting for a coach's manual review.
implementation: Schedule this daily after ingesting launch monitor ball speed events and investigate any drift days alongside notes about fatigue, travel, or conditions.
visualization: Timechart of daily ball speed in miles per hour with baseline and drift markers.
grandmaExplanation: It totals when launch monitor ball speed suddenly looks very different from your normal pattern.
